decks.notes: The deck focuses on utilizing cheap artifacts to quickly build a board presence and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures. By using cards like Ichor Wellspring and Myr Enforcer, the player can quickly amass a board presence that is difficult to deal with. Additionally, the deck includes removal spells like Galvanic Blast and Nihil Spellbomb to deal with threats from the opponent. The deck also includes ways to generate extra value through cards like Thoughtcast and makes use of artifact lands to power up Metalcraft abilities.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy using small white creatures and powerful auras to buff them up. By quickly building a board of weenies and boosting their strength with cards like Ethereal Armor and Hyena Umbra, the player can deal damage quickly and efficiently. The inclusion of protection spells like Emerge Unscathed and Benevolent Bodyguard helps to keep the creatures on the field and maintain pressure on the opponent. This deck aims to win the game through sheer speed and aggression.

This deck focuses on using low-cost creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The strategy involves using efficient cheap creatures like Ninja of the Deep Hours and Faerie Miscreant, backed up by disrupting spells like Counterspell and Spellstutter Sprite to maintain control of the board. Mutagenic Growth and other pump spells are used to increase the damage output of the creatures, while cards like Of One Mind help keep the hand full. The goal is to apply pressure early and maintain tempo throughout the game to secure a quick victory.

This pauper control deck focuses on using cards like Ephemerate to repeatedly trigger key abilities like flickering Mulldrifter for card advantage. The deck also includes a mix of bounce spells and counterspells to disrupt opponents' game plans. Sunscape Familiar and God-Pharaoh's Faithful help gain life as a buffer against aggressive decks, while Archaeomancer and Snap provide additional value by recurring key spells from the graveyard. The deck aims to outvalue opponents with its card advantage and control the game until it can establish a dominant position on the battlefield.

The main concept of this Gruul Aggro deck is to ramp up quickly with cards like Utopia Sprawl and Arbor Elf, and then disrupt the opponent's mana base with cards like Mwonvuli Acid-Moss and Thermokarst. The deck also includes aggressive creatures like Boarding Party, Avenging Hunter, and Annoyed Altisaur to apply pressure and quickly close out the game. Snow-Covered lands are included to synergize with cards like Skred and provide additional versatility. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy.

The main concept of this Pauper 1 vs 1 Control - Gates deck is to establish control on the battlefield by utilizing a combination of efficient removal spells like Flame Slash and Journey to Nowhere, along with defensive creatures like Guardian of the Guildpact and Kor Skyfisher. The deck also aims to ramp up its mana with cards like Gatecreeper Vine and Saruli Gatekeepers, while using the Gates as a way to fix mana and gain additional benefits from cards like Basilisk Gate and Citadel Gate. This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while building up its own board presence.

The primary focus of this deck is to establish control by utilizing a variety of counterspells and removal spells in conjunction with card draw and selection spells to ensure that the opponent's threats are neutralized. The deck also includes powerful finishers such as Gurmag Angler and Tolarian Terror to close out the game once control has been firmly established. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Fallaji Archaeologist and Unexpected Fangs provide additional value and utility in maintaining control over the game. The mana base is heavily blue-focused to support the heavy counter and card draw elements of the deck.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly ramp up your mana using cards like Arbor Elf, Utopia Sprawl, and Wild Growth, while disrupting your opponent's mana base with cards like Mwonvuli Acid-Moss and Thermokarst. Once you have enough mana, you can start playing big creatures like Annoyed Altisaur and Avenging Hunter to put a lot of pressure on your opponent. The deck also includes cards like Skred and Boarding Party for removal and Jewel Thief for card advantage. Overall, the strategy is to overwhelm your opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells.

The deck focuses on utilizing gates to control the board and protect key creatures like Guardian of the Guildpact and Kor Skyfisher. Cards like Journey to Nowhere, Flame Slash, and Lightning Bolt are used for removal and to maintain board control. The deck also includes cards like Saruli Gatekeepers and Thraben Inspector for value and card advantage. With a mix of creatures, removal spells, and efficient gates, the deck aims to outlast the opponent and control the game until it can close out with a powerful finisher or overwhelming board presence.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by using bounce spells and counterspells to disrupt the opponent's strategy. It also takes advantage of the Ephemerate mechanic to gain extra value from creatures with powerful enter-the-battlefield effects. The goal is to outvalue the opponent by repeatedly bouncing creatures like Sea Gate Oracle and Mulldrifter to draw cards and control the board. The deck also includes some lifegain elements and card draw to help survive and outlast the opponent in longer games.

This deck focuses on quickly building up a powerful creature by attaching multiple auras to it, increasing its power and resilience. The strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with a large, unblockable creature early in the game. Cards like Ancestral Mask, Ethereal Armor, and Armadillo Cloak help to pump up the creature while cards like Slippery Bogle and Silhana Ledgewalker make it difficult for the opponent to deal with. The deck also includes some protection and mana fixing to ensure a consistent and aggressive game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly get small, evasive creatures on the board and then load them up with powerful auras to pump them up and swing for big damage. By utilizing cards like Rancor, Ancestral Mask, and Ethereal Armor, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures that are difficult to deal with. The deck also includes cards like Utopia Sprawl and Abundant Growth to help ramp up mana and fix colors. Overall, the goal is to build a strong board presence early and keep the pressure on the opponent.

This Orzhov Aggro deck focuses on swiftly developing a board presence with efficient creatures like Kor Skyfisher and Spirited Companion, supported by powerful anthem effects from cards like Inspiring Overseer. Removal spells like Cast Down and Unmake ensure the path is clear for aggressive attacks, while additional value is gained from cards like Thraben Inspector and Ephemerate. The deck also contains some graveyard interaction with cards like Bojuka Bog and Omen of the Dead to disrupt opponents' strategies. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a relentless assault while maintaining some resilience through life gain and card advantage.

The main concept of this deck is to control the opponent's board and resources through various removal spells and disruption tools. It utilizes cards like Disfigure, Cast Down, and Chainer's Edict to eliminate threats on the battlefield. Additionally, it incorporates graveyard hate with Nihil Spellbomb and disruption with cards like Blood Fountain. The deck also has lifegain options with Unexpected Fangs and Ill-Gotten Inheritance to stabilize its own life total. The win condition of the deck is to use powerful creatures like Gurmag Angler, Vampire Sovereign, and Thorn of the Black Rose to close out the game.

The deck focuses on aggressive plays with a mix of creatures and removal spells in order to apply early pressure on the opponent and control the board. It utilizes the Orzhov color combination to efficiently generate card advantage and maintain a strong board presence. The deck features a balance of flying creatures, reanimation, and life gain to outmaneuver the opponent and secure victories through a combination of beatdown tactics and disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to disrupt your opponent's strategies and control the game through counterspells, card draw, and removal spells. It aims to outvalue the opponent by efficiently managing resources and utilizing graveyard recursion with cards like Fallaji Archaeologist and Gurmag Angler. The deck also includes snow-covered lands for potential synergies and has a strategic balance between disruption and win conditions with Tolarian Terror. Overall, this Dimir Control deck aims to consistently outplay opponents through careful decision-making and resource management.
